mwp_d14_reorg_validate_siege_effect = {
    mwp_d14_siege_census_effect = yes
    remove_variable = mwp_d14_reorg_siege_safe
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_d14_siege_observed
            var:mwp_d14_siege_observed = yes
            OR = {
                NOT = {
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = mwp_war_fort_weight_sum
                        var:mwp_war_fort_weight_sum > 0
                        var:mwp_d14_useful_siege_count = 1
                        exists = var:mwp_d14_last_useful_siege
                        exists = var:mwp_reorganization_victim
                        var:mwp_reorganization_victim = var:mwp_d14_last_useful_siege
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    has_variable = mwp_reorganization_planned_id
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 49
                            has_variable = mwp_assessed_siege_49
                            var:mwp_assessed_siege_49 > 0
                        }
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 51
                            has_variable = mwp_assessed_siege_51
                            var:mwp_assessed_siege_51 > 0
                        }
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 53

                            var:mwp_assessed_siege_53 > 0
                        }
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 54
                            has_variable = mwp_assessed_siege_54
                            var:mwp_assessed_siege_54 > 0
                        }
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 87
                            has_variable = mwp_assessed_siege_87
                            var:mwp_assessed_siege_87 > 0
                        }
                        AND = {
                            var:mwp_reorganization_planned_id = 108

                        }
                        AND = {

                        }
                        AND = {
